Messages.Body:

> So... If I understand correctly, it is still "Thaumaturgy" and "tha" in the card lists despite it being renamed to "Blood sorcery" in the V5 rulebook? Will this cause confusion?

For example, will a future vampire with the ability "Cards requiring Blood Sorcery cost this vampire 1 less blood" be able to pay Magic of the Smith - a Thaumaturgy card - for free?
